title: A failed posted mark leaves a live public reply recorded as unposted, so the caps under-count and cleanup can re-open the thread for a second reply
evidence: Survey 2026-11-12 (main 5187412d5); Fable ruled 2026-11-12: the claim is written before the post; a definite refusal from YouTube releases it; a timeout or unknown outcome keeps it, counts toward the caps, and cleanup never deletes it. At most one public reply. app/lib/youtube-bot-store.server.ts markPosted reports its error and returns; app/lib/youtube-bot.server.ts posting loop; the cleanup keeps the newest 200 unposted rows
